title: The best Cozi alternative for families in 2026
description: Looking for a Cozi alternative? Here is an honest look at what Cozi does well and where a newer, all-in-one option fits.
h1: The best Cozi alternative for families
directAnswer: Cozi is a solid free family calendar and list app, but it stops at scheduling and does not cover budgets, trips, or an AI assistant that can act for you. If you want a single private app that also handles money, chores, and travel, Kinrows is the closest all-in-one alternative, launching on iPhone this fall.

sections.heading: What Cozi does well
sections.html: Cozi is free, simple, and covers the calendar and shopping-list basics most families need first.

cta.heading: See the whole household in one app
cta.body: Kinrows brings the calendar, lists, budget and chores into one private app.
